account:
Today has appeared quiet on the surface: the secretary reported no correspondence or unusual concerns, and two residents at the market said they had no news. Still, there are hints of preparations I do not yet understand. My neighbour says the builder is coordinating ordinary supplies and lighting for the hall. The neighbour also heard from Townsfolk Two that lights were going up at the bakery, but has not confirmed the occasion. I saw the builder carrying a lantern near the inn. I tried asking him about the work, but he left without apparently hearing my question. Freight was also at the inn seeking the innkeeper to discuss a supply order; I do not know whether that is connected.

These could be preparations for a celebration or gathering involving the hall and perhaps the bakery, but that is only a suspicion. I have no confirmed occasion, organizer, or evidence that anything is deliberately being kept from me. My neighbour even asked whether I knew of an upcoming celebration.

I have kept my morning market appointment and am now home for the noon lunch period. Accounts at the office are scheduled for thirteen, tea with my neighbour at fifteen at the cottage at (16, -60, 105), and another office appointment at sixteen thirty. Those visits may offer natural opportunities to learn more.
